property_summary: After two successful fallback calls at timestamps t1 < t2, C stores pastBlockTime = t2, so a third call at any t3 with t2 < t3 succeeds; the mutant stores t1+t2, so for t3 with t2 < t3 <= t1+t2 the third call reverts.
change_summary: Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime += block.timestamp;` so pastBlockTime accumulates timestamps rather than storing the latest one.
